get_article_timeline.description: Chart how much a topic was covered, and how positively, over time. Choose a share of all coverage, a raw article count, the average tone, or a breakdown by language or publishing country. A breakdown returns one line per language or country GDELT monitors, so the ones with no coverage at all are left out, and 'How many lines' keeps just the busiest of the rest.

description: Search the world's news with GDELT, the open project that monitors online news in 65 languages and decades of US television news, and works out what each story is about and how positively it is told. No account or API key is needed. Search articles back to 2017 and the sentences a phrase appears in; chart how coverage and its tone move over time; and search television by what was said, written on screen or shown on camera.
